en: A present causal state is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a non-past non-causal state.
A present causal state is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a non-future non-causal state.
A present causal state is a condition, by way of root-condition, for both a non-past non-causal state and a non-future non-causal state.
Condition. (Abbreviated. Under root there are three; under object, nine; under predominance, six; under proximity, three ... pe ...
under conascence, three ... pe ... under non-disappearance, three.
